Restore parameters AND batchnorm buffers, optimizer/scaler, gradients, scheduler/EMA, CPU/CUDA RNG, data cursor and accumulation counters after disposable warmup. Assert restored state equals reference before timing. Test deliberately changed buffer/state rejection.

Create/verify project-local config/cache/temp directories before library imports; verify effective Ultralytics path and reject fallback. Preserve previous/tmpincident evidence, no deletion or permission changes.

Synchronize CUDA at phase boundaries; avoid hot-loop per-element host reads. Report raw two-repetition setup/decode/preprocess/H2D/compute/checkpoint/reload/total timing and peak memory. No hidden validation. Test changed input, collision, nonfinite loss, missing input, restore failure and OOM. Batch16conditional on headroom; first OOM stops that arm without automatic sweep.
